title: Grammy nominations: Raye leads with 11, ahead of Rosalía with nine
summary: The British singer equals the record for the most nominations by a woman in a single year.
body:
The British singer Raye leads the nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards with 11, including Album of the Year for This Music May Contain Hope. The nominations were announced on Monday 16 November.

Her total equals the record for the most nominations by a woman in one year, set by Beyoncé in 2025. Rosalía is next with nine, followed by Ella Langley, Olivia Rodrigo and Phoebe Bridgers with seven each.

Album of the Year nominees

  • Phoebe Bridgers, Lost Weekend
  • Olivia Dean, The Art of Loving
  • Ella Langley, Dandelion
  • Bruno Mars, The Romantic
  • Raye, This Music May Contain Hope
  • Olivia Rodrigo, You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love
  • Rosalía, Lux
  • Taylor Swift, The Life of a Showgirl

The ceremony takes place on 7 February in Los Angeles and will be shown on ABC, Disney+ and Hulu.

Sources: NPR, Deadline, ABC News.
